THE PRINTING SERVICE MINUTE OF THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING -
AMENDMENT No. 04

THE Public Service Commission has ordered to amend the Code of Printing Service Minutes of Department of GovernmentPrinting published in the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 1816/12 dated 26th June 2013 amended by theExtraordinary Gazette Notification No. 1892/40 dated 12th December 2014, No. 1893/39 dated 19th December 2014and No. 1981/43 dated 23rd August 2014 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, as follows.
By order of the Public Service Commission
M. A. B. DAYA SENARATH,
Secretary,Public Service Commission.On this 05th day of June, 2018.
(i) Paragraph 15.4 will be omitted and substituted the new paragraph as mentioned below :

15.4 - Up to a period of 07 years, since the approval of this service minute, out of the applicants who areselected for the Post of Letter Press Operator, Print Finisher, Pre Print Planner, Printing Editor and ComputerType Setter and Printing Designer, for the Print Finishers that mentioned under the 9th paragraph of theconstitution, selected from the internal applicants, getting through a Book Binding Course with a duration notless than 06 months conducted by the Sri Lanka Institute of Printing, and for the selected Letter Press MachineOperators, Pre Print Planner, Printing Editor and Computer Type Setter and Printing Designer getting througha practical test conducted by the Department of Government Printing after one year from the date they areselected for the posts, are adequate requirements for them to be appointed for the applicant who are selectedfor the Offset Litho Printing Machine Operators, from the internal applicants, it is adequate to get through acourse on Lithography with a duration not less than 06 months, conducted by the Sri Lanka Institute of Printingfor them to be appointed for permanent posts. After 07 years from the date of approval of this constitution, incase of the NVQ Level 5 will be existed, the provisons contained under Section 10.3 of this constitution mustbe applicable.
(ii) A new sub clause will included under 6 of the First Appendix as follows :

6 - (a) Applicants who have completed national Vocational Qualification Level 3 (NVQ Level 3) in a fieldrelevant to the applied post, are considered as the applicants who have already completed G. C. E. (Ordinary)Level qualification as requested in this Service Minute.

6 - (b) Applicants who have completed National Vocational Qualification Level 4 (NVQ Level 4) in a fieldrelevant to the applied post, are considered as the applicants who have already completed G. C. E. Advaned Levelqualification as requested in this Service Minute.
Note.- Above mentioned provisons are applicable only for the posts that requested a National Vocational QualificationLevel.
